### 2026-10-11 – i finished everything in one last hail mary this weekend a lot of it was spent on the code and more spicifically on trying to understand the original starbie's code and figuring out how i can make my

**6.02h**

i finished everything in one last hail mary this weekend a lot of it was spent on the code and more spicifically on trying to understand the original starbie's code and figuring out how i can make my own sprite and animations and i also picked up on some really big mistakes i made early on like giving the spi display scl and sda pin so i fixed a lot of those issues and made new animations and made a github repo and a readme and a zine
